wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 05-005 wires the sprite namespace, rotation/flip semantics, and the firstspritelump-relative frame cache into a runtime artifact the mobj simulator and renderer can consume. The new bridge at src/assets/wireSpriteFrameCacheFromIwadResourceCache.ts consumes an IwadResourceCache from 05-001 plus the underlying WAD byte buffer (intentionally NOT retained inside the cache per the 05-001 design) and produces a frozen SpriteFrameCache via the read-only buildSpriteFrameCache primitive. Failure modes (missing S_START/S_END markers, sprite lump size below patch-header bytes, sprite-name shape errors) propagate verbatim from the upstream primitives — no new error class is introduced.
